notes: Workflows never get stuck on a failed step: a step that reports a problem hands it to the checks after it, or the run waits with Try again or Carry on. Start a workflow from any step, and after a run, carry on or run it again from any card. Runs survive closing LATYS: they come back paused, with Resume. A new live run view: the team lights up, the camera follows the agents at work, each working card shows what its agent is doing, and a progress bar and captions tell the story. Close the Studio and the run keeps showing in a window on your project dashboard. Workflow agents now stop only the processes they started.
